claims.text: The resort is near the base of the McDowell Mountains, in the Gainey Ranch neighborhood.

findings.quote: Located near the base of the McDowell Mountains, the resort is part of the swanky Gainey Ranch neighborhood.

claims.text: The property was formerly known as Hyatt Regency Scottsdale Resort & Spa at Gainey Ranch and is the first Grand Hyatt hotel in Arizona.

findings.quote: The property, formerly known as Hyatt Regency Scottsdale Resort & Spa at Gainey Ranch, marks the first Grand Hyatt hotel in Arizona.

claims.text: Big movable glass walls in the lobby and on the back of the resort are usually kept open.

findings.quote: the big, movable glass walls in the lobby and on the backside of the resort spend far more time open than closed

claims.text: The water playground has a winding waterslide, a sandy beach entry, family-friendly pools and private cabanas.

findings.quote: From our winding waterslide and sandy beach entry to family-friendly pools and private cabanas, there’s something for every age to enjoy.

claims.text: Spa Avania has a Himalayan Salt Room and a full-service hair and nail salon.

findings.quote: don’t forget about the Himalayan Salt Room, and full-service hair and nail salon

claims.text: Gainey Ranch Golf Club is available exclusively to private club members and guests of the resort.

findings.quote: Gainey Ranch Golf Club, one of the top-rated golf courses in the Southwest, exclusively available to private club members and guests of Grand Hyatt Scottsdale Resort

claims.text: Every guest room, in every room category, has a balcony or patio.

findings.quote: Every guest room, regardless of room category, features a balcony or patio, adding to the light and airy aesthetic.

claims.text: Mountain View king rooms have views of the McDowell Mountains from the balcony.

findings.quote: take in the dramatic views of the McDowell Mountains from the balcony

claims.text: The Casita Suite sits along the resort's waterways and has a wood-burning fireplace.

findings.quote: Retreat to unparalleled luxury in our stunning 1,200-square-foot Casita, nestled along the resort’s tranquil waterways. Featuring a plush king bed, expansive living and dining areas, and a wood-burning fireplace

claims.text: The Casita Suite can be expanded into a four-bedroom configuration.

findings.quote: The option to expand into a four-bedroom configuration ensures an unparalleled Scottsdale experience during your stay.

claims.text: The resort's restaurants are under the direction of chef and James Beard-nominated cookbook author Richard Blais.

findings.quote: all masterfully crafted by celebrated chef and James Beard-nominated cookbook author Richard Blais

claims.text: La Zozzona is a fine dining restaurant devoted to Italian American cuisine.

findings.quote: Discover La Zozzona, a sophisticated fine dining tribute to Italian American cuisine

claims.text: The resort has a 2.5-acre water playground.
Gainey Ranch Golf Club offers 27 holes of championship golf with views of the McDowell Mountains.

findings.quote: This golfer's paradise offers 27 holes of championship golf and breathtaking views of the McDowell Mountains.

claims.text: Spa Avania has an outdoor pool flanked by fountains and fireplaces, and a garden patio with a hot tub and cold plunge.

findings.quote: lounge by the outdoor pool flanked by fountains and fireplaces, or the lush garden patio with a hot tub and cold plunge. Spa Avania features 19 treatment rooms

claims.text: The Casita Suite's rooftop deck has views of the lake and golf course.

findings.quote: the rooftop deck offers breathtaking views of the lake and golf course

claims.text: The resort is inspired by Frank Lloyd Wright, with open spaces that blend with the natural landscape.

findings.quote: Inspired by Frank Lloyd Wright, open spaces mingle harmoniously with the natural landscape.
